supersedes: method-review.json (earlier review of the controller candidate)
withdrawal_reason: The controller selected one bounded squared-error estimator. The earlier Gamma draft was never fitted; keeping it active would introduce a second method and a different training loss. It is withdrawn without changing any old-model arithmetic or rerunning the diagnostic.

selected_candidate.penalty: 0.001 fixed before future evaluation, standardized slopes only; intercept unpenalized
selected_candidate.mean_baseline: exact arithmetic mean of matured historical risk labels, not a logistic fit or Gamma floor
selected_candidate.training_preprocessing: training-only mean and population standard deviation ddof0
selected_candidate.optimizer: one fixed starting point SciPy L-BFGS-B, convergence settings to be frozen by the next contract
comparators: five price backgrounds plus continuous AAII

review.addresses: predictions respect future maximum-drop support and standardized slopes are constrained
review.not_proved: neither out-of-period error improvement nor repair of existing models; no new model has been fitted
unresolved: future risk information relative to mean/volatility

minimum_next_contract_details: freeze one initialization, e.g. intercept logit(matured mean risk fraction), slopes0; explicitly handle exact mean0or1
freeze max iterations and gradient/objective tolerance plus final convergence and gradient checks
retain start/final penalized objectives and reject a final objective worse than the fixed start
evaluate actual unmodified risk percentage-point labels on the same complete dates; no outcome-selected variants
